column2: The Central Bank shall, without prejudice to the

column1: provisions of section 6, support the general economic policy
framework of the Government as provided for in any law
with a view to encouraging and promoting the development
of the productive resources of Sri Lanka.

column2: (1) The Central Bank shall have the power to make

column1: such rules or issue such directions as it may consider necessary
for exercising, performing and discharging the powers, duties
and functions entrusted to the Central Bank by or under this
Act or any other written law.

column2: (2) A rule made by the Central Bank shall have general

column1: application.  It  shall  be  binding  in  its  entirety  and  directly
applicable.

column2: (3)  A  direction  issued  by  the  Central  Bank  shall  be

column1: binding on the addressee only.

column2: (1) Every rule or order made by the Central Bank

column1: under this Act shall be published in the Gazette and shall,
except any rule or order specified in subsection (2), come
into force on the date of such publication or on such later
date as such rule or order shall specify.

column2: (2) Upon the publication under subsection (1), every rule

column1: or  order,  the  contravention  of,  or  failure  to  comply  with
which, entails criminal sanction shall, within three months
from the date of publication, be placed before Parliament for
approval.  Such  rule  or  order  shall  come  into  force  on  the
date on which such rule or order is approved by Parliament.

column2: (3) The Central Bank shall maintain a public register of

column1: its published rules and directions.
